notes.title: The Definitive Edition update is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32012539/be11243413d4163a90420b6776728f00db97141e.png[/img]

Available for free, the Definitive Edition update brings with it new content and features, including two new dungeons, game modifiers, tracking achievements in-game and other improvements to the game.

With this last major update to the game, The Adventures of Elena Temple now features:
[list]
[*] 3 dungeons with a total of 100+ rooms to overcome, each its own mini-level
[*] Unique gameplay elements for each dungeon
[*] Open exploration, choose which way to go, but don't worry, a helpful map is just one button press away
[*] Challenging, old-school platforming
[*] Put your puzzle solving skills to the test and figure out how to collect all the coins, gems, hearts and so on
[*] Track the progress of all 40 achievements in-game
[*] Unlockable game modifiers for completely new ways to experience the game
[*] Secrets and easter eggs to find for the more observant player
[*] Play on a selection of 7 virtual old machines, from the Pomo D'or 4, to Maple and Some Toy and all the way to the NS-Bos PC
[/list]

Thank you for all your support and Happy Holidays!

notes.title: The Adventures of Elena Temple: Definitve Edition
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33127533/482dcdea853fc1d97869d9bbf54e24d312d880d0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Great news![/h1]
The Adventures of Elena Temple: Definitive Edition will be available on December 24th as a free content update and will include:
[list]
[*] 2 new dungeons, totaling 47 new rooms - some very well hidden - with unique gameplay elements
[*] 20 new achievements, for a total of 40 - their progress is now also available in-game
[*] Unlockable game modifiers - Limited Lives, Campfires, Double Jumps, Infinite Ammo - combine them for unique gameplay experiences
[*] On the fly switching between the virtual old machines
[*] Various tweaks to the rooms in the original dungeon, now dubbed Chalice of the Gods - you got shivers, didn't you?
[*] Overall improvements: new background in the selection screen, new pixel art splash image, dungeon selection screen, game modifiers screen etc.
[*] Easter Eggs
[/list]

[h1]Warning![/h1]
The Definitive Edition will only be available for Windows users. All support for the Mac version of the game ended with version 1.2.0.

In the following days there will be various changes to the achievements list and the Steam page in preparation for the December 24th update.

Thank you for all your support this far and I hope you will enjoy the new content!

notes.title: Update 1.2 brings you closer to the screen
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33127533/4a15b54bd52544a831879b6393523a0ce7814734.jpg[/img]

A new update is available for The Adventures of Elena Temple, bringing with it a resolution to the much requested fullscreen feature. The reason I've been avoiding to have such an option until now is because I didn't feel the game lent itself well enough to be rendered fullscreen. The game area of only 240x160 pixels rendered on a Full HD screen or even bigger didn't feel right, first because each pixel in the game area became way too big and second because the aspect ratio didn't match, leading to some weird cropping especially on some of the virtual platforms.

My solution? A zoom in/out functionality! You can get closer to the virtual screen or further away using the gamepad trigger buttons or '[' and ']' on your keyboard - yes, I know, a very programmer's choice of keys here! The zoom factor is saved for future sessions too, as long as you don't change the virtual platform or the display resolution - if you do, it just snaps back to its default zoom factor and you'll need to readjust to whatever works best for you, for the current combo of virtual platform and display resolution. This can also be used as a small trick to reset the zoom factor to its default state - just choose another virtual machine and then switch back to the current one and voila, default is back in fashion!

The update also includes some small level tweaks and a fix for a super rare bug of not unlocking the achievements related to collecting the secret scrolls.

I hope you enjoy the new zoom functionality and hopefully you'll find it an elegant solution to not being able to render the actual retro game fullscreen - it still won't be completely fullscreen, but it will be as near as possible while still maintaining a good looking crop. Plus it gives the chance to everyone to be as close to the virtual screen as they like! Just don't blame me if your virtual mom yells at you that you'll ruin your virtual eyes from staying so close to the virtual screen!

Thank you again for playing The Adventures of Elena Temple!

notes.title: What's new in Update 1.1
notes.content:
It's official! Update 1.1 for The Adventures of Elena Temple comes to Steam on May 28th. It feels better, shakes better and challenges better! And it'll sure be worth it to have a vibrations supporting controller nearby!

But enough from me, here's more from myself on what the new update includes:
[list]
[*]Stats screen with various info about your playthrough, like the time played, number deaths, enemies killed etc. and also the best values for these fields over all your playthroughs
[*]Medals for each field in the Stats screen, get them like a pro by finishing the game in less than 40 minutes, dying less than 20 times, shooting less than 100 bullets and more
[*]Screen shakes for all, including on death, enemy kills, walls move or destroy and many more
[*]Vibrations for controllers supporting this feature
[*]Lots of improvements to the final rooms of the game
[*]5 challenging new achievements to unlock
[*]New music tracks for the secret rooms, final rooms and post game credits
[*]A bunch of bug fixes, tweaks and even optimizations, not that those were really necessary
[*]Save icon to indicate when the game is, uhm, saved..
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1 coming soon!
notes.content:
Just a quick update to let you know that I'm working on an update with lots of goodies and it should be available in around a week, give or take a few days. If you see some new achievements in the list and you don't know how to unlock them, it's because you'll need update 1.1 first.

So get your vibrations supporting controllers ready as you wait for the new features, improvements and, of course, the mandatory bug fixes! More details coming soon!
